g.text: pipeline/name_suggest.py proposes groups for unreviewed registry names with character 3-4-gram TF-IDF
and cosine similarity, requiring a word that belongs to one group only. Leave-one-out precision on the reviewed
names was 98.7%, but on real unreviewed names about one suggestion in five was wrong (for example "DELTA
Energie" to Delta Air Lines). Suggestions are therefore never published; they go to
